		days_re_enable = 90

			if = {

	COLDWAR_AP_propose_normalisation = {
		icon = GFX_decision_generic_political_discourse
		cost = 50
		days_re_enable = 90
		target_root_trigger = { COLDWAR_AP_host = yes }
		target_trigger = { FROM = { COLDWAR_AP_sub_saharan = yes NOT = { COLDWAR_AP_colonial_or_minority = yes } NOT = { tag = ROOT } } }
		visible = { FROM = { COLDWAR_AP_sub_saharan = yes NOT = { COLDWAR_AP_colonial_or_minority = yes } NOT = { tag = ROOT } } }
		available = { COLDWAR_AP_host = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_political_mandate check_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_political > 0 } OR = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_political < 3 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_services < 3 } } NOT = { has_war_with = FROM }
		if = { limit = { tag = SAF } FROM = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_pending_SAF } NOT = { COLDWAR_AP_SAF_normalisation_active = yes } } }
		if = { limit = { tag = ZIM } FROM = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_pending_ZIM } NOT = { COLDWAR_AP_ZIM_normalisation_active = yes } } }
		if = { limit = { tag = NAM } FROM = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_pending_NAM } NOT = { COLDWAR_AP_NAM_normalisation_active = yes } } }
		}
		complete_effect = {
			custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_AP_if_accepted
			if = {
				limit = { tag = SAF COLDWAR_AP_host = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_political_mandate check_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_political > 0 } OR = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_political < 3 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_services < 3 } } NOT = { has_war_with = FROM } FROM = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_pending_SAF } NOT = { COLDWAR_AP_SAF_normalisation_active = yes } } }
				effect_tooltip = {
					FROM = {
					set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_preview_opinion = SAF.COLDWAR_AP_political }
					multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_preview_opinion = 12.5 }
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_customs_contact_SAF } }
						add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_regional_trade = COLDWAR_AP_preview_opinion tooltip = COLDWAR_AP_regional_trade_tt }
					}
					
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_regional_diplomatic = COLDWAR_AP_preview_opinion tooltip = COLDWAR_AP_regional_diplomatic_tt }
					}
					SAF = {
					set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_preview_opinion = SAF.COLDWAR_AP_political }
					multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_preview_opinion = 12.5 }
					if = {
						limit = { FROM = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_customs_contact_SAF } } }
						add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_regional_trade = COLDWAR_AP_preview_opinion tooltip = COLDWAR_AP_regional_trade_tt }
					}
					
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_regional_diplomatic = COLDWAR_AP_preview_opinion tooltip = COLDWAR_AP_regional_diplomatic_tt }
					}
				}
				hidden_effect = { FROM = { set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_AP_pending_SAF days = 180 } } }
			}
			
			if = {
				limit = { tag = ZIM COLDWAR_AP_host = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_political_mandate check_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_political > 0 } OR = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_political < 3 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_services < 3 } } NOT = { has_war_with = FROM } FROM = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_pending_ZIM } NOT = { COLDWAR_AP_ZIM_normalisation_active = yes } } }
				effect_tooltip = {
					FROM = {
					set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_preview_opinion = ZIM.COLDWAR_AP_political }
					multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_preview_opinion = 12.5 }
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_regional_trade = COLDWAR_AP_preview_opinion tooltip = COLDWAR_AP_regional_trade_tt }
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_regional_diplomatic = COLDWAR_AP_preview_opinion tooltip = COLDWAR_AP_regional_diplomatic_tt }
					}
					ZIM = {
					set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_preview_opinion = ZIM.COLDWAR_AP_political }
					multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_preview_opinion = 12.5 }
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_regional_trade = COLDWAR_AP_preview_opinion tooltip = COLDWAR_AP_regional_trade_tt }
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_regional_diplomatic = COLDWAR_AP_preview_opinion tooltip = COLDWAR_AP_regional_diplomatic_tt }
					}
				}
				hidden_effect = { FROM = { set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_AP_pending_ZIM days = 180 } } }
			}
			
			if = {
				limit = { tag = NAM COLDWAR_AP_host = yes has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_political_mandate check_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_political > 0 } OR = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_political < 3 } check_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_services < 3 } } NOT = { has_war_with = FROM } FROM = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_pending_NAM } NOT = { COLDWAR_AP_NAM_normalisation_active = yes } } }

	COLDWAR_AP_accept_SAF = {
		icon = GFX_decision_generic_political_discourse
		cost = 0
		visible = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_pending_SAF }
		available = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_pending_SAF
		COLDWAR_AP_sub_saharan = yes
		NOT = { COLDWAR_AP_colonial_or_minority = yes }
		NOT = { has_war_with = SAF }
		COLDWAR_AP_SAF_concessions = yes }
		complete_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_pending_SAF
				COLDWAR_AP_sub_saharan = yes
				NOT = { COLDWAR_AP_colonial_or_minority = yes }
				NOT = { has_war_with = SAF }
				COLDWAR_AP_SAF_concessions = yes }
				effect_tooltip = {
					THIS = {
					set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_preview_opinion = SAF.COLDWAR_AP_political }
					multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_preview_opinion = 12.5 }
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_customs_contact_SAF } }
						add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_regional_trade = COLDWAR_AP_preview_opinion tooltip = COLDWAR_AP_regional_trade_tt }
					}
					
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_regional_diplomatic = COLDWAR_AP_preview_opinion tooltip = COLDWAR_AP_regional_diplomatic_tt }
					}
					SAF = {
					set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_preview_opinion = SAF.COLDWAR_AP_political }
					multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_preview_opinion = 12.5 }
					if = {
						limit = { ROOT = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_customs_contact_SAF } } }
						add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_regional_trade = COLDWAR_AP_preview_opinion tooltip = COLDWAR_AP_regional_trade_tt }
					}
					
					add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_AP_regional_diplomatic = COLDWAR_AP_preview_opinion tooltip = COLDWAR_AP_regional_diplomatic_tt }
					}
				}
				hidden_effect = {
					clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_pending_SAF
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_AP_normalised_SAF
					SAF = { COLDWAR_AP_relations_SAF = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = { factor = 0 }
	}
